meta.title: Make Windows terminal shell type detection immediate like macOS
meta.body_summary: Eliminate a hardcoded 300ms async delay on Windows terminal shell type detection by using the executable path already known at creation, making detection immediate (~1ms) like macOS.

perf_labels.notes: Tiny 20-line perf PR with numeric 320x claim but no evidence; closed without any review or comment, leaving reason unknown.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 20 changed lines, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a tiny, focused performance micro-optimization that was closed—not merged—without any review engagement.

review_details.performance_claim: Shell type detection on Windows is now immediate (~1ms) instead of async with a ~300ms delay, approximately 320x faster, matching macOS behavior.

core_change_summary.description: In src/vs/platform/terminal/node/windowsShellHelper.ts, added optional initialExecutable parameter to constructor to detect shell type immediately from basename and set _shellType and _shellTitle; in terminalProcess.ts, pass shellLaunchConfig.executable to WindowsShellHelper and fire immediate event if detection succeeded, preserving async fallback.
